name: Roller Rabbit
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $133 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); Premium (rule reading); hand-band check advised: pajama/resort brand
why: Block-printed cotton pajamas (around $128), ready-to-wear, kids' clothes, accessories and bedding, sold through its own stores and website.

quote.q: Perfection doesn't interest us. Our hope is to create our own world, where happiness is our truest measure of success.

opview: “Perfection doesn't interest us. Our hope is to create our own world, where happiness is our truest measure of success.” — Roller Rabbit (house), About Us, rollerrabbit.com

facts_read.source: brand site; nordstrom.com; Vinted brand page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database; Houstonia 2016-06-07; site terms

T-shirt.lp: Mini Monkey Blossom Pointelle Classic Tee

price_read.sublines: Roller Rabbit women's ready-to-wear (casual, pima knits, tops, knits, bottoms, dresses, outerwear); EXCLUDED: pajamas/loungewear (its largest category), robes, swim, cover-ups, bedding/bath, baby/kids, men's, accessories, stocked vendors (Hat Attack, maxbone and others)

doors.note: site rollerrabbit.com (/pages/stores is a 404; the footer link goes to /pages/our-stores); 14 rows: 11 boutiques incl. Charleston (closed for renovation, reopening 17 October, returned as temporarily closed), 2 outlets (Belmont Park Village, Nashville); The General Store by RR in Nantucket is an own door, a multi-brand shop under the brand's name (ruled 10 Oct); no concessions or pop-ups listed although the page title mentions pop-up events; no per-store pages, source_url is the locator page; the worklist's 'kids, plus home' lines are sold in these same stores

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 from 176 in-stock women's clothing styles (style stem from the feed tag, e.g. WDR-SU26-547; the print suffix is the colourway and collap

tech_evidence.names: NONE (house fabric names such as Pima Soft and Dream Fleece are lounge cloths, not technical claims)

craft_evidence.owned: no (about page: 'we still work with many of the family-owned factories that we started with 20+ years ago', unnamed)
craft_evidence.madein: about 78% — 138 of 176 in-stock clothing styles state a country (India 114, Peru 12, Portugal 7, Vietnam 2, and 3 readin
craft_evidence.heritage: placed, not dated: 'The Roller Rabbit story began in India' with hand block-printed cotton; '20+ years' with its factories (about-us page)
craft_evidence.process: partial — the-originals page says the prints are hand block-printed in Jaipur and tells how several began; making of the garments not described
craft_evidence.reasoning: Most product pages state a country (mainly India), and the site describes hand block-printing in Jaipur and long relationships with family-owned factories, but no factory, printer or mill is named and nothing is owned. A 2, or a 3 only if the Jaipur block-print story is taken as naming the maker.
